# Keys `github-env.sh` may write to the runner env file, one per line. Every key
# is `CI_JOB_[A-Z0-9_]+`, a job-local name no runner or tool variable shares.
# `verify-manifest.py` refuses a key that wraps or replaces rustc
# (RUSTC_WRAPPER, CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC, ...), an interpreter/loader hook (PATH,
# LD_PRELOAD, BASH_ENV, NODE_OPTIONS, ...), or a runner-reserved prefix.
CI_JOB_BIN_NAME
CI_JOB_FOCUS_ACROSS_PATCH_BIN
CI_JOB_FOCUS_SERVER_PID
CI_JOB_GEO_CLIPBOARD_BIN
CI_JOB_GEO_CLIPBOARD_EMITTED
CI_JOB_GEO_SERVER_PID
CI_JOB_LAYOUT_FILL_BIN
CI_JOB_LAYOUT_SERVER_PID
CI_JOB_PUBLISH_SIGNING_KEY
CI_JOB_WS_ECHO_PID
